_meta.source: Amazon Feed Error Agent knowledge base (original spec sections 16-17), structured. Entries are guidance, never a substitute for reading the full error message. Same code can have several sub-types: always key on code + message + attribute + marketplace + template version.

5461.title: New ASIN creation restricted for brand
5461.cause: Seller is not authorised to create a new ASIN for this brand.
diagnose: Check whether the ASIN already exists
Confirm a new ASIN is really required
solution: If the ASIN exists: attach the offer to it
If a new ASIN is needed: apply for brand approval
Use the brand name exactly as confirmed by Amazon

5665.title: Brand name not approved
5665.cause: Amazon does not allow this brand name for listing creation.
solution: Request approval for the brand name or use the already approved exact spelling

8026.title: Not authorised for category / product line
8026.cause: Seller lacks permission for this category or product line.
solution: Request category approval in Seller Central
Usually not solvable by editing a cell

8058.title: Missing or invalid required field
8058.auto_fix: only when the value follows unambiguously from the template and the field is not protected
8058.cause: Required attribute empty or value not allowed.
solution: Fill the required field with a valid value from the current Amazon template

8541.title: Single matching error
8541.cause: GTIN/Product ID matches an existing ASIN but submitted attributes (brand, title, color, size, package quantity, model/part number) conflict with the catalog.
diagnose: Compare merchant value vs Amazon value
Confirm the physical product really is that ASIN
solution: If ASIN is right: use catalog-compatible values
If product differs: verify EAN/UPC/GTIN
If the Amazon catalog is wrong: start catalog correction / support; do not falsify data to pass the feed

8542.title: Multiple matching error
8542.cause: Product ID maps to several candidate ASINs and the attributes do not disambiguate.
solution: Align data to the correct catalog match
Escalate if the Amazon catalog is wrong

8560.title: Invalid data / missing required fields / Product ID does not match ASIN
8560.cause: Several possible causes: invalid product ID, wrong UPC/EAN/ISBN length or format, missing required attributes, wrong item/product type, Product ID not matching the existing ASIN, missing fields for new ASIN creation. NEVER interpret by the code alone.
diagnose: Decide: match existing ASIN or create new
solution: Fix per the specific sub-cause

8572.title: GTIN does not match product
8572.cause: UPC/EAN/ISBN/JAN does not correspond to the product according to Amazon/GS1 data.
solution: Use the correct GS1 GTIN or give Amazon supporting documentation

8573.title: Potential matching products found
8573.cause: Amazon believes the product may already exist in the catalog.
solution: If it exists: use the existing listing
If it does not exist: follow the contact instruction in the error text

99001.title: Missing columns or invalid values
99001.cause: Required columns missing or values with a wrong format/type; template structure may have been damaged.
solution: Restore the required columns/values and rebuild the submission from the CLEAN source feed without changing template structure

4400.title: Product requires review
4400.cause: Amazon requires review/approval for this product.
solution: Submit the relevant request/application through Seller Support / Seller Central
Usually no feed-only fix

90202.title: Restricted item or brand
90202.cause: Item or brand is restricted for this seller account / marketplace.
solution: Request approval

6024.title: Restricted item or brand
6024.cause: Item or brand is restricted for this seller account / marketplace.
solution: Request approval

invalid_unit: check value + unit as one pair
catalog_value_conflict: never accept the Amazon value automatically without confirming the physical product
duplicate_sku_or_identifier: attempt to create a second ASIN?
